title: ARIBA

brief_context: Architect who designed a kitchen for BBC Television's Tomorrow's World.
brief_extract:
Tomorrow's kitchens
Most of us are content if we can have as convenient a kitchen as possible designed along conventional lines but some forward looking architects are trying to overcome some of the basic problems with all kitchen planning in their designs for kitchens for tomorrow. In a kitchen designed by John Prizeman, ARIBA, for BBC Television's Tomorrow's World, the design is based on a single cluster of units which can be installed in the centre of whichever room is to be the kitchen. As the units are free of the walls they are not affected by the positions of doors and windows and they incorporate storage space the problem of finding sufficient wall space for cupboards is overcome.
